advisoryFindings.title: Broaden prose-field coverage for semantic deferral
advisoryFindings.improvement: Add small cases that put the trigger words in title, body, reason, and guardrail text fields, not only observed/reason-shaped fields.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: Existing tests already exercise semantic deferral despite words like missing, test, command, and tooling, so the core requirement has executable coverage; this would make the coverage more explicit.

advisoryFindings.title: Add review-side structured precheck variants
advisoryFindings.improvement: Consider adding review retry cases for non-semantic structured failures beyond TOOLING_FAILURE and coverage headers, such as command exit, invalid schema, no-progress, flow-state corruption, and malformed artifact markers.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The suite covers the structured classifier directly and includes review-side TOOLING_FAILURE and coverage-header paths, so this is extra parity coverage rather than a missing executable requirement.
